metadata.name: Delivery With A Deadline
metadata.author: Agreements Protocol
metadata.description: A supplier delivers before a due date fixed when the agreement is created. From the due date on, the buyer may record the delivery as late. Shows time windows on inputs.

dueDate.name: Due Date
dueDate.description: Delivery deadline, in seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC

lateNote.name: Late Delivery Note
lateNote.description: Why the delivery is recorded as late

AWAITING_DELIVERY.name: Awaiting Delivery
AWAITING_DELIVERY.description: The supplier has until the due date to deliver.

DELIVERED.name: Delivered
DELIVERED.description: The supplier delivered before the due date.

LATE.name: Late
LATE.description: The due date passed without a delivery.

initialize.name: Initialize Delivery
initialize.description: Store the parties and the due date

deliver.description: The supplier records the delivery. Accepted only before the due date.

declareLate.description: The buyer records that nothing was delivered in time. Accepted from the due date on.
